errors.evidence: The categories on the x-axis (Pb-Acid, Ni-Cd, Ni-MH, Li-Ion, Solid State) are not in alphabetical order. They are ordered by increasing energy density.
The chart does not specify the units of measurement for the y-axis. Stating they are 'probably Wh/kg' is an assumption not supported by the visual data.

errors.text_span: без да са сортирани по височина
errors.evidence: The categories are clearly sorted in ascending order of their corresponding values (bar heights), from the lowest energy density (Pb-Acid) to the highest (Solid State). The statement that they are not sorted by height is incorrect.
